newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Environmental damage delays Venezuela CVG sale.
newsitem.headline: Environmental damage delays Venezuela CVG sale.

text.p: Venezuela has delayed the slated sale of aluminum companies in the Corporacion Venezolana de Guayana (CVG) industrial complex until the second quarter of the year, financial daily Economia Hoy reported.

Venezuelan Investment Fund president Alberto Poletto said the sale had been postponed as it had not yet been determined whether the new investor or the FIV would be responsible for clearing up environmental damage, the paper reported.
Potential buyers have until January 31 to post final comments on the sale contracts, which will then be forwarded to Congress for final debate.

The FIV had previously hoped to sell the four companies on January 31, receiving some $1.3 billion after debts of $1.6 billion were paid. The companies include: Venalum and Alcasa, both smelters; Bauxilum, a bauxite and alumina company; and Carbonorca, a carbon anodes producer.
